what: FreeCAD Fasteners Workbench dimension tables (FsData/*def.csv) for ISO 4762, ISO 7380-1/-2, ISO 10642, ISO 4026/4027/4029, ISO 4032, ISO 4035, ISO 7089, ISO 7093-1 and DIN 508, each def CSV carrying its own 'length' (standard nominal lengths with tolerances) and 'range' (per-size min/max length) sections, plus iso888length.csv (the ISO 888 nominal-length series), iso262def.csv (ISO 262 coarse/fine pitches), standard_diameters.csv (per-standard min/max diameter) and DiaList.csv (inch size to mm). Stored verbatim; never edited here. Read by catalog_import.py into DimensionSource + MechPartFamily rows (mxc-1).
licence_source: The repository's LICENSE file (copied verbatim beside this file): GNU GENERAL PUBLIC LICENSE Version 2, June 1991. No '-or-later' statement found in the LICENSE file; the GitHub licence detector reports GPL-2.0. Dimension values themselves transcribe public ISO/DIN standard tables (facts); the CSV arrangement is the workbench's.
gpl3_compatible: NOT as code: GPL-2.0-only cannot be relinked into a GPL-3.0 program. We do not import or run any workbench code; we read the CSV tables as DATA at seed-generation time and store the resulting numbers (standard-defined dimensions) in our own rows, citing this source and sha. Flag for the licence gate (AI-Notes/evaluations) if the tables themselves are ever redistributed as part of a release artifact.
upstream_path: FsData/ (the per-standard CSV tables) and LICENSE
fetched_from: econ-core (this shell), via the GitHub REST API (commit lookup) and raw.githubusercontent.com pinned to the commit sha below; no clone, no code from these files was ever executed here. Parsed only by modules/mech/custom/catalog_import.py run with python3 -I.
